scope: Background, ambient and accent visuals in the active src game; eight sectors and three camera rigs preserved.

refined.changes: Procedural continent, ocean, cloud and ice detail; projection-aware atmospheric limb and sunlight-facing terminator; fine ring bands with a broad gap. Reuses the existing two body meshes.
Subdued nebula energy to separate the playfield; star density uniform now controls both layers. Existing baked cubemap, PMREM, shadow rig and sector palettes retained.

Layered roof shading, rooftop equipment, window rows, quieter avenues and subtle shader-driven traffic. City UVs stay anchored while nebula drift remains slow. Fixed underlay edge fade to use the rotated plane XZ axes.

Fitted rooftop caps, vents, parapets and supported warning lights; fixtures follow tower yaw and taper; separated warm window panes. Replaces oversized or detached cyan strips within existing material batches.
More geometric silhouette detail with continuous erosion and impact-basin displacement; softer cool rim. World positions, decorative clearance and orbit paths unchanged.
Cached procedural billowing alpha texture, short fade-in and varied rotation for shared smoke pool. Rotated sprite UVs clip outside their bounds. Immediate additive sparks retained.
Repeatable seeded GPU field, varied magnitudes, subtle shimmer, shorter quieter streaks and lower opacity near the aiming corridor. Still one fixed line draw.
Reduced film grain amplitude from 0.045 to 0.022. Existing bloom, damage, boost and CRT behavior retained.

reviewed_retained: Runway chase lights and sector conduits
Altitude grid, shadow and aiming cues

validation.production_browser: Desktop, touch portrait and touch landscape passed with no JavaScript errors or failed requests
validation.campaign: Invulnerable scripted pilot completed all eight sectors, victory and Loop 2 without errors

limits: Live human visual/motion and sustained device performance acceptance remains separate from these automated checks.
Low-quality catalogue predates only the final minor rooftop fixture seating adjustment; final production smoke and high-quality catalogue include it.
Campaign CPU measurements ran alongside other validation and are not an isolated performance benchmark.
Changes are local, uncommitted and not published.
